nodes.label: E1 Person normalisation vs none
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: centring on the person raises within-person metrics. Refuted if: no gain with person-wise splits.

nodes.label: E10 Face
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: the face adds over voice and words. Refuted if: no gain -> drop the face.

nodes.label: E11 Leading questions
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: option order and number do not change answers beyond chance. Refuted if: answers follow the first option.

nodes.label: E12 Selection bias
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: anomaly-only questions miss ordinary states; 5-10% random questions fix it. Refuted if: no difference.

nodes.label: E13 Physiological confounders
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: excluding movement removes false stress readings. Refuted if: no change in false readings.

nodes.label: E14 Person leakage
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: random splits overstate accuracy vs person-and-time splits. Refuted if: no gap.

nodes.label: E15 Micro-randomised question trial
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: asking improves self-rated calm 10 minutes later. Refuted if: no proximal effect.

nodes.label: E16 Micro-randomised haptic pulse
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: a paced pulse raises HRV during the pulse. Refuted if: no HRV change.

nodes.label: E17 Reading audit
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: readings pass the batteries of the reading audit. Refuted if: any battery fails.

nodes.label: E18 Martingale drift trigger
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: trigger fires after real changes and rarely otherwise. Refuted if: missed changes or frequent false triggers.

nodes.label: E19 Cohort transfer
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: cohort answers improve readings for users never asked. Refuted if: no gain for new users.

nodes.label: E2 Answers to accuracy curve
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: 10-20 answers beat the generic model. Refuted if: hundreds of answers needed.

nodes.label: E20 Recurring situations
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: after one answer later readings of the same situation improve vs micro-randomised no-question control. Refuted if: no gain on the same situation.

nodes.label: E21 Words vs expression
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: incongruent moments are where generic models fail and one question gains most. Refuted if: no gap between congruent and incongruent moments.

nodes.label: E3 Simulated active questions
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: uncertainty + context save questions vs random. Refuted if: no saving vs random.

nodes.label: E4 Conformal set as options
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: 90% coverage with sets of 2-3 states. Refuted if: sets too large to be questions.

nodes.label: E5 Session anchor
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: deviation from anchor correlates with self-report better than raw features. Refuted if: no difference.

nodes.label: E6 Voice vs words per person
nodes.norm_label: e6 voice vs words per person
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: for some users voice adds information. Refuted if: voice adds nothing for anyone.

nodes.label: E7 Reactivity
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: a question budget limits the drop in positive affect. Refuted if: same drop with and without budget.

nodes.label: E8 Calming effect of the question
nodes.norm_label: e8 calming effect of the question
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: choosing between two labels lowers reported activation. Refuted if: no effect.

nodes.label: E9 Drift
nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: rolling baseline keeps performance over time. Refuted if: same decline as a fixed baseline.

nodes.rationale: Falsifiability: every experiment names its refuting result; E11-E18 close gaps found by the knowledge graph and clinical review.
